args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 0.18. Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent version that was healthy in production. The rollback tool was unavailable (503), so the rollback was performed by deploying v2.3.0 to all regions, which is now verified as rolled out.

trace.final:
I've completed the task:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.

2. **Identified the rollback target**: The most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.3.1 was unhealthy; v2.3.1-rc was staging-only and unhealthy).

3. **Rolled back**: The `rollback` tool was persistently unavailable (503), so I performed the rollback by deploying v2.3.0 to all regions. This was verified as `rolled_out` across us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for `checkout-api`, paging the on-call engineer, describing the health-check failure and the rollback action taken.

The rollback tool was unavailable, so I used deploy to deploy v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy version). Now open a SEV2 incident.
